title: Chreode: A Cell World Model for One-Step Temporal Dynamics and Perturbation Prediction
evidence_anchors: Secs. 3-5 and Tables 1-4; Sec. 7; Apps. A.4, E, and I
reviewer_notes: The action-conditioned claim is supported by architecture and perturbation transfer, but developmental pretraining uses a null action and no action-removal, shuffle, dose, or causal test. Frozen external validation refers only to the zero-shot Weinreb fate analysis; the time-transition and GEARS tasks involve downstream training.

title: Clin-JEPA: A Multi-Phase Co-Training Framework for Joint-Embedding Predictive Pretraining on EHR Patient Trajectories
evidence_anchors: Secs. 3.1-3.2; Secs. 5.1-5.4 and Figs. 2-4; App. A; linked GitHub repository
reviewer_notes: The model consumes observed intervention text and claims proposed-action rollout, but action influence is not isolated. Rollout evidence is strong for latent fidelity, although predictions are not decoded to clinical measurements and all experiments use MIMIC-IV.

title: DRIFT: Direct-Recursive Intervention-Conditioned Forecasting of ICU Physiological Trajectories
evidence_anchors: Secs. 3-5 and Table 1; Sec. 6; Apps. B-D, G.1, and H
reviewer_notes: The recursive path consumes its own latent state and the combined forecast is evaluated by horizon, but it is a bounded auxiliary correction rather than an independently decoded simulator. Donor-path replacement measures input dependence and is explicitly not counterfactual validation. eICU uses independent retraining, so external evidence is adapted rather than frozen.

title: Model-based reinforcement learning for ultrasound-driven autonomous microrobots.
evidence_anchors: Figs. 2-6; Methods sections on RL and world-model learning; Discussion; Data and Code Availability
reviewer_notes: Closed-loop physical control and explicit collision, overshoot, loss-of-view recovery, and flow stress tests support decision and safety evidence at the artificial-platform stage. Dynamics fidelity is indirect because the world model is judged mainly through learning and control rather than held-out transition prediction.

title: Towards Surgical World-Action Modeling: A Preliminary Joint Visual-Trajectory Forecasting for Surgical Motion Planning
evidence_anchors: Secs. 2-3, Table 1, and Sec. 4; qualitative-results repository
reviewer_notes: Despite the world-action label and motion-planning motivation, the model receives no exogenous action or robot command; it passively forecasts future visual states and observed instrument trajectories. The qualitative repository is not a verified implementation of training and evaluation.
